2. Battery group size chart

Battery group size refers to physical dimensions, not electrical capacity.

Best all-around choice: A 12V 100Ah LiFePO4 battery for a compatible 12V trolling motor, or a 24V 100Ah LiFePO4 battery for a compatible 24V system. Group 31 is a common choice for larger lead-acid deep-cycle batteries.

Best Trolling Motor Battery Size Chart

The best trolling motor battery size depends on your motor's thrust (lb), voltage (12V/24V/36V), power consumption, and desired runtime.

For most anglers, a 100Ah LiFePO4 lithium battery is a great starting point because it offers long runtime, lighter weight, and more usable capacity than a comparable lead-acid battery.

These are general sizing recommendations, not manufacturer requirements. Check your motor's specified voltage and maximum current draw.

Important: A 24V motor needs a 24V battery bank, and a 36V motor needs a 36V battery bank. For example, you can power a 24V motor with two compatible 12V batteries connected in series.

Uses 90% usable capacity for lithium and 50% for lead-acid as planning assumptions. Actual runtime depends on motor speed, current, wind, battery condition, and discharge limits.
4. Best battery size by application

Kayak: 12V 50Ah LiFePO4 for portability.

Small fishing boat: 12V 100Ah LiFePO4 for a 55 lb motor.

Bass boat: 24V 100Ah LiFePO4 battery bank for an 80 lb motor.

Large fishing boat: 36V 100Ah LiFePO4 battery bank for a 112 lb motor.

Before buying, verify the battery's continuous discharge rating, motor compatibility, charging requirements, and the manufacturer's circuit protection recommendations.
